name: Kanyashree Prakalpa
description: United Nations award-winning conditional cash transfer scheme in West Bengal incentivizing schooling and delaying child marriage of adolescent girls.
descriptionHindi: बालिकाओं की शिक्षा को बढ़ावा देने, बाल विवाह रोकने और उच्च शिक्षा हेतु वित्तीय अनुदान देने वाली संयुक्त राष्ट्र पुरस्कृत योजना।
ministry: Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, West Bengal
benefits: Annual scholarship (K1) of ₹1,000 for unmarried girls aged 13-18 enrolled in classes 8-12, and a one-time grant (K2) of ₹25,000 upon turning 18.
benefitsHindi: कक्षा 8-12 की छात्राओं को ₹1,000 वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति तथा 18 वर्ष पूर्ण होने पर ₹25,000 का एकमुश्त अनुदान।
eligibilityText: Unmarried girls residing in West Bengal enrolled in recognized schools, madrasahs, or colleges aged between 13 and 19 years.
eligibilityTextHindi: पश्चिम बंगाल की मान्यता प्राप्त स्कूलों में पढ़ने वाली 13 से 19 वर्ष की अविवाहित छात्राएं।
sourceName: Kanyashree Portal, Government of West Bengal
